# epresso

> A modern, Python-first static site generator. Routes-as-code, content collections, deterministic + incremental builds, and a no-JavaScript-by-default philosophy.

- [epresso](https://nikoshell.github.io/epresso/): A modern, Python-first static site generator.

## Basics

- [Get started](https://nikoshell.github.io/epresso/basics/): How an epresso site is structured and its core building blocks.

- [Pages](https://nikoshell.github.io/epresso/basics/pages/)
- [Project structure](https://nikoshell.github.io/epresso/basics/project-structure/)
